title: Frontend: Get Weekday
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Get Weekday. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Parse a real calendar date YYYY-MM-DD in UTC and return its English weekday. Reject nonexistent dates or malformed text with Invalid date. Do not mix UTC parsing and local formatting. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Date. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Treat YYYY-MM-DD as calendar fields rather than blindly parsing a timestamp.
alternativeApproaches: Add locale-specific weekday labels while preserving the same calendar date.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Month boundary; leap day; invalid date.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
